verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer offers client-facing platforms that store client data (GDHQ corporate records, Contract Generator, D&O Questionnaire Portal, Catalyze), so the question of where that data is stored is a fair one to ask. The evidence pack never mentions letting users choose a storage region or residency. ChatGD's use of an enterprise OpenAI instance on Microsoft Azure is an internal attorney tool and says nothing about user-selectable data location.
